title: quick-fix Argentinian ovolimushroom wood-fired-bake
description: A quick and flavorful Argentinian dish that combines the earthy flavors of mushrooms with the crunchy texture of ovoli, all on a wood-fired bake.
instructions: Toss ovoli and mushrooms with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes on a baking sheet.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic on top of the ovoli mixture.
Drizzle chimichurri mix over the top and toss to combine.
Transfer the baking sheet to the preheated wood-fired oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the ovoli is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese over the top.
Return the baking sheet to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Slice the ovoli and serve hot, garnished with additional chimichurri mix if desired.
